response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack experience across TypeScript, Node.js, React, and cloud tools like AWS CDK, with direct exposure to AI-agent infrastructure and testing frameworks like Vitest — aligning well with the core stack and responsibilities. His 6+ years of relevant roles, open-source contributions, and architecture-level work demonstrate depth, though his lack of explicit Nest.js and Kotlin/Java experience and basic German language skills are minor gaps.
strengths: Proven full-stack expertise with TypeScript, Node.js, React, and AWS CDK
Hands-on experience with AI-agent infrastructure and agentic workflows
Strong track record in testing, DevOps, and open-source contributions
concerns: No explicit mention of Nest.js or Kotlin/Java in recent roles
German language proficiency is only basic, may limit collaboration in Berlin-based teams
Resume lacks detail on relational databases (PostgreSQL/MySQL) and Kubernetes deployment scale
